row.evidence: Sprinto's docs say you integrate an identity provider (Google Workspace, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID) or HRMS tool and Sprinto imports the staff directory, or add staff manually or by CSV; no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: Sprinto pulls its staff directory from the customer's IdP or HRMS through its own API integrations (for Okta, an API token Sprinto uses to fetch users and groups), plus manual entry and CSV. Admin Portal users must already exist as staff and get one of five access roles. No SCIM endpoint appears in the docs sitemap, llms-full.txt or the developer API. Settings include an 'SSO Login' area, but no SSO setup guide or plan is published. The GraphQL Developer API (beta, admin API key, 10 req/min) can mark staff in or out of scope but not create or remove users. The pricing page returned 403 to every fetch, so plans and prices are not recorded.

scim.notes: available=false by absence: staff arrive by Sprinto-run IdP/HRMS sync, manual entry or CSV; no SCIM endpoint documented.

capabilities.notes: Documented staff operations are markStaffAsInScope / not-in-scope and background-verification upload; no create/remove user operations documented.

rate_limits.text: 10 requests/min per IP address and per API key; exceeding it blocks API access for 10 minutes.

limitations.text: The Developer API is in beta and may change.

okta.notes: Sprinto-run pull of users and groups with an Okta API token; okta.com/integrations/sprinto/ returns 404.

entra.notes: Entra gallery tutorials sprinto-tutorial and sprinto-provisioning-tutorial return 404.

fallbacks.other_sync: Sprinto-run directory sync from IdPs (Google Workspace, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Office365) and HRMS tools (e.g. Breathe, GreytHR, Zoho People)
